spec.description: What Faro sees in the browser: sessions, web vitals, what users do, what breaks, and the trace behind a failed call.

spec.title: Sessions
spec.description: New Faro sessions in the time range.

spec.title: Sessions with no problems
spec.description: Share of sessions with no browser exception and no frustrated click.

spec.title: Exceptions
spec.description: Errors Faro caught in the browser.

spec.title: Frustrated clicks
spec.description: Rage, dead and error clicks.

spec.title: Largest Contentful Paint (p75)
spec.description: How long the main content takes to appear. Good under 2.5 s, poor over 4 s. Headless test browsers on localhost are far faster than real users.

spec.title: Interaction to Next Paint (p75)
spec.description: How quickly the page reacts to a click. Good under 200 ms, poor over 500 ms.

spec.title: Shopping funnel
spec.description: How many visitors made it to each step, counted from Faro events. The drop between steps is where people give up or hit trouble.

spec.expr: sum by (step) (count_over_time({service_name="coffee-cart-frontend",kind="event"} |~ "event_name=(view_product|add_to_cart|checkout_started|order_placed) " | logfmt | label_format step=`{{ if eq .event_name "view_product" }}1. Viewed a product{{ else if eq .event_name "add_to_cart" }}2. Added to cart{{ else if eq .event_name "checkout_started" }}3. Started checkout{{ else }}4. Placed an order{{ end }}` [$__range]))

spec.title: Page views per minute, by view
spec.description: Which pages people spend their time on.

spec.title: Most used actions
spec.description: Faro user actions: a click plus everything it caused.

spec.expr: topk(10, sum by (action) (count_over_time({service_name="coffee-cart-frontend",kind="event"} |= "event_name=faro.user.action" | logfmt | label_format action=`{{.event_data_userActionName}}` [$__range])))

spec.title: How long each action takes (p95)
spec.description: The 95th percentile time from click to everything settled, per action. This is what users wait for, including the API calls and rendering.

spec.title: Exceptions per minute, by type
spec.description: Errors thrown in the browser, caught by Faro.

spec.title: Top exceptions
spec.description: Most frequent exceptions by type and message.

spec.expr: topk(8, sum by (err) (count_over_time({service_name="coffee-cart-frontend",kind="exception"} | logfmt | label_format err=`{{.type}}: {{.value}}` [$__range])))

spec.title: Exceptions by page
spec.description: Which view the user was on when the error happened.

spec.title: Exceptions by browser and OS
spec.description: Is one platform worse than the rest?

spec.expr: sum by (who) (count_over_time({service_name="coffee-cart-frontend",kind="exception"} | logfmt | label_format who=`{{.browser_name}} on {{.browser_os}}` [$__range]))

spec.title: Frustration signals per minute
spec.description: Rage clicks, dead clicks and error clicks.

spec.title: Where users get frustrated
spec.description: Frustration grouped by the action the user was attempting.

spec.expr: sum by (what) (count_over_time({service_name="coffee-cart-frontend",kind="event"} |= "event_name=faro.frustration" | logfmt | label_format what=`{{ trimPrefix "faro.frustration." .event_name }} on {{ if .event_data_userActionName }}{{ .event_data_userActionName }}{{ else }}(no action){{ end }}` [$__range]))

spec.title: Recent exceptions, with the trace of the failed call
spec.description: Exceptions from a failed API call carry the trace of that call: click its trace ID to open the browser span and the backend spans together. Browser-only exceptions (a broken image, a bug in the UI code) made no request, so they have no trace.

spec.title: Stack traces (source-mapped)
spec.description: The full stack of each exception, with original file names and line numbers (Alloy applies the source maps from the build), plus the page, user and session it happened to. Expand a line for every field.

spec.expr:
{service_name="coffee-cart-frontend",kind="exception"} | logfmt | line_format `{{.stacktrace}}
    view={{.view_name}}  user={{.user_username}}  session={{.session_id}}  {{ if .traceID }}trace={{.traceID}}{{ else }}(no trace: no request behind it){{ end }}`

spec.title: Browser traces with errors
spec.description: Traces started in the browser where something failed. Open one to see the click, the API call and the backend spans.

spec.title: Slowest browser traces
spec.description: Browser traces that took over half a second.

spec.title: Session timeline
spec.description: Events, errors and measurements for the chosen session, oldest first. Expand a line for every field.

spec.expr: {service_name="coffee-cart-frontend"} | logfmt | session_id=~"$sessionId" | event_name!~"faro.performance.*|faro.tracing.fetch" | line_format "{{.kind}}  {{.event_name}}{{.type}}  view={{.view_name}}  action={{.event_data_userActionName}}  user={{.user_username}}  session={{.session_id}}"

spec.title: Traces from this session
spec.description: Browser traces. Open one to see the click, the API call and the backend spans in one waterfall.
